facts.fact: Angola's Data Protection Agency (APD) board of directors says it fined MAXAM US$150,000-equivalent for an illegal transfer to the UK, and Banco Comercial do Huambo and UNITEL US$75,000-equivalent each, by deliberations 001-003 of 30 April and 19 June 2024.
The APD's Board of Directors, acting under article 53 of Law 22/11 of 17 June, issued the fining deliberations, so the authority is in post.
